plugins.name: secret-input-card
plugins.description: Use any API key, token or password without exposing it in the chat: you paste it into a protected card, the plugin saves it to a gitignored .env file or the macOS Keychain, and Claude gets only the variable name, so the programs it runs can use the secret.

plugins.name: laboratorio-novantir
plugins.description: Puts a Novantir app on the home lab server as a client prototype or staging, following the lab manual (compose contract, project setup, deploy from the Mac, Cloudflare Tunnel hostnames).

plugins.name: full-stop-send
plugins.description: Takes an issue to a merge-ready pull request with proof, an independent review and green CI, then stops (Full Stop); merges on its own (Full Send) only for the change class the repository allows in writing.
